name: ML Robustness & Evasion Testing
description: Assessment of machine learning model resilience against adversarial inputs. Covers crafting adversarial examples, evaluating model robustness boundaries, and testing detection and classification systems under evasion conditions.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to adversarial ML concepts

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands the concept of adversarial examples and why ML models can be brittle
evidence: Can explain what adversarial perturbations are and why they succeed
Aware of the difference between white-box, black-box, and transfer attacks
Familiar with the MITRE ATLAS adversarial ML landscape

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Can run existing adversarial attack tooling and interpret results under guidance
evidence: Generates adversarial examples against image or text classifiers using established libraries
Evaluates model accuracy under adversarial perturbation budgets

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses model robustness and produces actionable findings
evidence: Selects appropriate attack strategies based on model access level and threat model
Evaluates both targeted and untargeted evasion across modalities
Produces robustness assessment reports with quantified success rates and practical mitigations
Tests adversarial defenses for effectiveness and identifies bypass conditions

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Develops custom adversarial strategies; assesses novel model architectures; mentors others
evidence: Designs attack strategies for non-standard models or deployment scenarios
Evaluates robustness of deployed ML pipelines end-to-end, including pre- and post-processing
Reviews and calibrates robustness assessments across the team
Develops internal tooling or methodology for adversarial evaluation

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's adversarial ML assessment practice; publishes research
evidence: Established the lab's ML robustness assessment methodology
Published research on adversarial attacks, defenses, or robustness evaluation
Trains teams on adversarial ML assessment
Contributes to external standards or industry guidance

assessment_methods.description: Given a deployed classifier, craft adversarial inputs that achieve targeted misclassification and document the attack surface
Review robustness assessment reports for technical depth, appropriate attack selection, and actionable mitigations
